facts.text: Carrots, dinner is on me tonight. Don't ask where the money came from, just enjoy the blueberries.
facts.why: Invented. Nick's real line is 'It's called a hustle, sweetheart.' Also Nick never buys dinner in the film.

facts.text: The blueberries Judy brings Nick from the family farm.
facts.why: Judy does not bring Nick blueberries. The blueberries from her family's farm are what she swaps into Bellwether's weapon at the end.
facts.fix: the Hopps family farm blueberries that save the day
facts.applied_note: Kept lower case to match the other dish notes. Poster brief scene changed too.
